title: Cross-module boundaries
objective: A provider must be exported by its owning module and imported through that module to be visible elsewhere.
misconception: ReportsModule imports TasksModule but cannot resolve TasksService because it is not exported.
acceptance: Compile a real Nest TestingModule and resolve ReportsService with a mocked TasksService provider.
securityBoundary: Avoid broad global modules that expose private services across unrelated trust boundaries.
